dialogues.jp: また、今日もいじめられた。
dialogues.en: I was picked on by a bully again today.
dialogues.text: I was picked on by a bully again today.

dialogues.en: (Hm?)
dialogues.text: (Hm?)

dialogues.jp: （また誰かの夢か……）
dialogues.en: (It must be somebody's dream.)
dialogues.text: (It must be somebody's dream.)

dialogues.jp:
（慣れちまうと毎度毎度、どうでもいいことだ
　が）
dialogues.en: (Actually, I don't care about it, after all.)
dialogues.text: (Actually, I don't care about it, after all.)

dialogues.jp: （いじめとは、今日の夢は嫌な感じだな）
dialogues.en: (Today's dream is about bullying, which I don't like.)
dialogues.text: (Today's dream is about bullying, which I don't like.)

dialogues.jp: （いつも通り、気にしないことにしよう……）
dialogues.en: (I try not to worry about it as usual.)
dialogues.text: (I try not to worry about it as usual.)

dialogues.jp:
（そうすれば、いつも通り、朝起きれば内容な
　んて忘れている……）
dialogues.en: (So, I won't remember when I get up in the morning.)
dialogues.text: (So, I won't remember when I get up in the morning.)

dialogues.jp:
髪の色とか目の色が違うとか、背が低いからと
か。
dialogues.en:
My hair and eyes are a different color to everyone else's,
plus I'm short.
dialogues.text:
My hair and eyes are a different color to everyone else's,
plus I'm short.

dialogues.jp:
口調が変だとか、性格が悪いとか、ブスとか
……。
dialogues.en: I talk weird, I have a nasty character and I'm ugly.
dialogues.text: I talk weird, I have a nasty character and I'm ugly.

dialogues.jp:
つまるところ、ボクに良いところなんてひとつ
もないんだ。
dialogues.en: In fact, I don't have any good part in me.
dialogues.text: In fact, I don't have any good part in me.

dialogues.jp: それでもいい。
dialogues.en: But that's okay.
dialogues.text: But that's okay.

dialogues.jp:
転校してきたボクはよそ者なんだから、いじめ
られても仕方ないだろうけど。
dialogues.en:
I think I have to deal with bullying because I'm a newcomer
here.
dialogues.text:
I think I have to deal with bullying because I'm a newcomer
here.

dialogues.jp: 可愛くなくたっていい……だけど。
dialogues.en: I don't care if I'm not cute, but...
dialogues.text: I don't care if I'm not cute, but...

dialogues.jp:
ボクのことは、なにを言われてもいいんだけど、
おばあちゃんの悪口だけが我慢できなかった。
dialogues.en:
I can cope with any insults about me, but not about my
grandma.
dialogues.text:
I can cope with any insults about me, but not about my
grandma.

dialogues.jp: 魔女――だって。
dialogues.en: They think she is a witch...
dialogues.text: They think she is a witch...

dialogues.jp: 桜の咲く日当たりのいい縁側。
dialogues.en: On the sunny porch with cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text: On the sunny porch with cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「だから喧嘩してきたの？」
dialogues.en: "Is that why you got into a fight with them?"
dialogues.text: "Is that why you got into a fight with them?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ……喧嘩と祭りは江戸の華なんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, fights and festivals are the spectacular events in
Edo."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, fights and festivals are the spectacular events in
Edo."

dialogues.jp: （さくらの夢！？）
dialogues.en: (Sakura's dream?)
dialogues.text: (Sakura's dream?)

dialogues.jp: 驚いた。
dialogues.en: I was surprised.
dialogues.text: I was surprised.

dialogues.jp:
いつも他人の夢を見ているが、さくらの夢は初
めてかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
This may be the first time I've seen Sakura's dream, while
I've seen so many others before.
dialogues.text:
This may be the first time I've seen Sakura's dream, while
I've seen so many others before.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、これだけ身近に住んでいるのに、
どうしてかアイツの夢だけは見ていなかった
……。
dialogues.en:
I live very close to her, but I don't know why I never saw
her dream before.
dialogues.text:
I live very close to her, but I don't know why I never saw
her dream before.

dialogues.jp:
ずっと、さくらに対する抵抗があるのだと思っ
ていたが……。
dialogues.en:
I thought it was because of my relationship with Sakura, but
this time, it is due to alcohol.
dialogues.text:
I thought it was because of my relationship with Sakura, but
this time, it is due to alcohol.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「あなた江戸ッ子じゃないでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "You're not a native of Edo, are you?"
dialogues.text: "You're not a native of Edo, are you?"

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんがやさしく首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Grandma tilts her head gently.
dialogues.text: Grandma tilts her head gently.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだけど……みんなよりボクのほうが日本
　のこと知ってるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"I know I'm not, but I know more about Japan than anybody
else."
dialogues.text:
"I know I'm not, but I know more about Japan than anybody
else."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「時代劇とか？」
dialogues.en: "Like samurai movies?"
dialogues.text: "Like samurai movies?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。日本人は義理と人情を思いやって、
　弱い人をみんなで守るんだよ……そうなんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. Japanese people like duty and sentiment, and they try
to protect people from trouble."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. Japanese people like duty and sentiment, and they try
to protect people from trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「って言っても度が過ぎるのは良くないと言う
　か……説明が面倒ね」
dialogues.en:
"But too much is not good. Oh, dear, how can I explain
this."
dialogues.text:
"But too much is not good. Oh, dear, how can I explain
this."

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんがこめかみを押さえてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: Grandma gives a sigh, rubbing her temples.
dialogues.text: Grandma gives a sigh, rubbing her temples.

dialogues.jp: う〜ん、さすが俺のばあちゃんだ。
dialogues.en: Whoa, that's my grandma.
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's my grandma.

dialogues.jp:
今まで死んでいたので理想化していたようだが、
段々と正体を思い出してきた気がする。
dialogues.en:
I guess I've had a glamorized image of her since she died,
but I start to remember who she was.
dialogues.text:
I guess I've had a glamorized image of her since she died,
but I start to remember who she was.

dialogues.jp:
甘党で面倒くさがりで、悪戯好きで子供っぽく
て、それでいてやさしい人。
dialogues.en:
She had a sweet tooth, she was hassle-averse, she liked
teasing like a child, but she was a very nice person.
dialogues.text:
She had a sweet tooth, she was hassle-averse, she liked
teasing like a child, but she was a very nice person.

dialogues.jp: そして、魔法使い。
dialogues.en: And she was a witch.
dialogues.text: And she was a witch.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、お祭りはいいけど、やっぱり喧嘩はい
　けないのよ」
dialogues.en: "I like festivals, but fighting is not good."
dialogues.text: "I like festivals, but fighting is not good."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……そうだけどさ、あの子たち、おばあちゃ
　んのこと悪く言うんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "I know that, but they call you bad things."
dialogues.text: "I know that, but they call you bad things."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「子供になにを言われたって、私は別に大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "I don't care what the little kids say about me."
dialogues.text: "I don't care what the little kids say about me."

dialogues.jp: にこり、とばあちゃんが爽やかに微笑む。
dialogues.en: Grandma gives a lovely smile.
dialogues.text: Grandma gives a lovely smile.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「しょせんガキの｛たわごと／戯言｝なんだから」
dialogues.en: "It's only brats' bullshit."
dialogues.text: "It's only brats' bullshit."

dialogues.en: (What?)
dialogues.text: (What?)

dialogues.jp:
ガン、と灯油缶で小気味よく頭を殴られたよう
なショック。
dialogues.en: I am shocked as if I got hit by a bucket.
dialogues.text: I am shocked as if I got hit by a bucket.

dialogues.jp:
俺の前ではここまで砕けていなかったが、なに
かさくらの口の悪さの発端を垣間見た気が……。
dialogues.en:
She never said that kind of thing in front of me, but now I
know where Sakura got her filthy mouth.
dialogues.text:
She never said that kind of thing in front of me, but now I
know where Sakura got her filthy mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「それに、みんなさくらが嫌いなんじゃなくて、
　お前のことが可愛いからいじめるのよ」
dialogues.en:
"They pester you not because they don't like you, but they
think you're too cute."
dialogues.text:
"They pester you not because they don't like you, but they
think you're too cute."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「可愛い？　……ボク可愛くなんてないもん」
dialogues.en: "Cute? I'm not cute."
dialogues.text: "Cute? I'm not cute."

dialogues.jp:
いじめられ続けて意固地になっているのか、さ
くらがヘナヘナと眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura raises her eyebrows, as if she is being obstinate
because of the bullying.
dialogues.text:
Sakura raises her eyebrows, as if she is being obstinate
because of the bullying.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「可愛いわよ。だって私の若い頃にそっくりだ
　もの」
dialogues.en:
"You're cute because you look exactly like me when I was
young."
dialogues.text:
"You're cute because you look exactly like me when I was
young."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?!"
dialogues.text: "Huh?!"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「……なに驚いてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you so surprised?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you so surprised?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え、やっぱりボク可愛くないよ」
dialogues.en: "Um... I don't think I'm cute."
dialogues.text: "Um... I don't think I'm cute."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Why not?"
dialogues.text: "Why not?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だって、おばあちゃんそっくりなんでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Because I look like grandma, right?"
dialogues.text: "Because I look like grandma, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「……まったくこの子は」
dialogues.en: "What a brat!"
dialogues.text: "What a brat!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「痛っ、にゃにゃにゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Ouch! Hee!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch! Hee!"

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんがさくらの頬を両手でひっぱる。
dialogues.en: Grandma yanks Sakura's cheeks with both hands.
dialogues.text: Grandma yanks Sakura's cheeks with both hands.

dialogues.jp: あ、なんか夢の中でまで｛めまい／眩暈｝がしてきた……。
dialogues.en: Oh, I feel dizzy even in the dream.
dialogues.text: Oh, I feel dizzy even in the dream.

dialogues.jp: 理想がこなごなになるというのか。
dialogues.en: Or I would say the dream goes into pieces.
dialogues.text: Or I would say the dream goes into pieces.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら色々と嫌なことがあって、俺は自
己防衛のために、ばあちゃんのことを忘れてい
たのではないか……？
dialogues.en:
The reason why I don't remember my grandma very much might
be to erase all the bad memories in self-defense.
dialogues.text:
The reason why I don't remember my grandma very much might
be to erase all the bad memories in self-defense.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「いじめられたりするのは、この口がいけない
　のかなぁ？」
dialogues.en: "I wonder if the reason you get picked on is my bad mouth."
dialogues.text: "I wonder if the reason you get picked on is my bad mouth."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「嘘、嘘だよ！　美人だなぁボク！」
dialogues.en: "No, I was joking, I'm pretty!"
dialogues.text: "No, I was joking, I'm pretty!"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「そうよ美人よ〜、なんなら、私の昔の肖像画
　とかアルバム持ってこようか？」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, you are. I can show you my old pictures and
self-portrait if you want to see."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, you are. I can show you my old pictures and
self-portrait if you want to see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「い、いいよいいよ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no thanks, it's okay!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, no thanks, it's okay!"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「そうね、押し入れを漁るのも面倒だし、何百
　年分となると重いしね」
dialogues.en:
"Really? Anyway, it's a hassle to look for them in the
closet, and it could be too heavy to bring all hundreds of
years' worth of them."
dialogues.text:
"Really? Anyway, it's a hassle to look for them in the
closet, and it could be too heavy to bring all hundreds of
years' worth of them."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「ほほほほほ♪」
dialogues.en: "Hohohoho..."
dialogues.text: "Hohohoho..."

dialogues.jp: 俺も笑いたい気分だ。
dialogues.en: I feel like laughing, too.
dialogues.text: I feel like laughing, too.

dialogues.jp: 「誰それ？」
dialogues.en: "Who's that?"
dialogues.text: "Who's that?"

dialogues.jp: と、小さな影が乱入してきた。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, a tiny shadow barges in.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, a tiny shadow barges in.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「おや学校は終わったのかい……って、さくら
　が帰ってきたんだからそうなんだね」
dialogues.en: "Is school over? Of course, that's why Sakura is home."
dialogues.text: "Is school over? Of course, that's why Sakura is home."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「うん。で、誰？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, but who is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, but who is it?"

dialogues.jp: 子供の頃の俺か……なんか小憎たらしいな。
dialogues.en:
I think that's me when I was a child... He looks very
naughty.
dialogues.text:
I think that's me when I was a child... He looks very
naughty.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「事情があって私が預かることになったのよ
　……元は海外で暮らしてたんだけどね」
dialogues.en:
"I will take care of him. He used to live in a foreign
country before."
dialogues.text:
"I will take care of him. He used to live in a foreign
country before."

dialogues.jp: ぽん、とばあちゃんが、さくらの背を叩く。
dialogues.en: Grandma taps Sakura on the back.
dialogues.text: Grandma taps Sakura on the back.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、自己紹介しなさいな」
dialogues.en: "Hey, introduce yourself."
dialogues.text: "Hey, introduce yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……誰この人？」
dialogues.en: "Who's this?"
dialogues.text: "Who's this?"

dialogues.jp: 怖々と俺を見上げる瞳。
dialogues.en: I see fearful eyes gazing up at me.
dialogues.text: I see fearful eyes gazing up at me.

dialogues.jp: 「名前を聞くときは自分からだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You should introduce yourself first, then ask the person's
name."
dialogues.text:
"You should introduce yourself first, then ask the person's
name."

dialogues.jp: ……最初に聞いたのは｛おれ／お前｝やん。
dialogues.en: I'm the one who asked first.
dialogues.text: I'm the one who asked first.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……芳乃さくら」
dialogues.en: "I'm Sakura Yoshino."
dialogues.text: "I'm Sakura Yoshino."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.jp: 子供の俺が首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: I, as a child, tilt my head.
dialogues.text: I, as a child, tilt my head.

dialogues.jp:
「さくらって呼ぶと花と間違えるから、さくら
　んぼにしよう」
dialogues.en:
"If I call you Sakura, it sounds like a cherry blossom, so
I'll call you Sakuranbo."
dialogues.text:
"If I call you Sakura, it sounds like a cherry blossom, so
I'll call you Sakuranbo."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにを！？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お前の名前だよ。ちょうど服も赤いし、さく
　らんぼっぽいだろ？　今日の給食にもでたん
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm talking about your name. Plus, the clothes you're
wearing are red, and I just had cherries at lunch."
dialogues.text:
"I'm talking about your name. Plus, the clothes you're
wearing are red, and I just had cherries at lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ……良い名前だねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it's a good name."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it's a good name."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにが！？」
dialogues.en: "What is?"
dialogues.text: "What is?"

dialogues.jp: 両側からの攻勢にさくらがビクビクと首を振る。
dialogues.en: Sakura shakes her head at their offensive action.
dialogues.text: Sakura shakes her head at their offensive action.

dialogues.jp:
この後、いじめもなくなって騒がしい本性を現
したさくらに、俺は頭が上がらなくなるわけか
……。
dialogues.en:
That's how I started to give her a little respect when she
showed her boisterous nature once the bullying stopped.
dialogues.text:
That's how I started to give her a little respect when she
showed her boisterous nature once the bullying stopped.

dialogues.jp: 確かに時間の流れは無常だ……。
dialogues.en: Times are always changing, for sure...
dialogues.text: Times are always changing, for sure...

dialogues.jp: 「俺は朝倉[name]」
dialogues.en: "My name is Junichi Asakura."
dialogues.text: "My name is Junichi Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、隣に住んでる、おばあちゃんの娘の子
　供だよ」
dialogues.en: "You know, he's the son of my daughter who lives next door."
dialogues.text: "You know, he's the son of my daughter who lives next door."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 子供ふたりが首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Both of them tilt their heads.
dialogues.text: Both of them tilt their heads.

dialogues.jp:
この時代の子供にとっては、母親が祖母の娘
――という認識は出来ないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I don't think they have the concept that his mother is
grandma's daughter.
dialogues.text:
I don't think they have the concept that his mother is
grandma's daughter.

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんはばあちゃんで、母親は母親でしか
ないのだ。
dialogues.en:
Their grandma is just grandma and their mother is just
mother.
dialogues.text:
Their grandma is just grandma and their mother is just
mother.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく兄妹みたいなものよ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, you are like sister and brother."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, you are like sister and brother."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクのこといじめる？」
dialogues.en: "Will you pick on me?"
dialogues.text: "Will you pick on me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いじめられてるの？　――コイツ」
dialogues.en: "Is she already being picked on?"
dialogues.text: "Is she already being picked on?"

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらを示しながら、ばあちゃんに｛き／訊｝く。
dialogues.en: I asked grandma, pointing at Sakura.
dialogues.text: I asked grandma, pointing at Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「仲良くしてやってくれないかねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Be nice to her."
dialogues.text: "Be nice to her."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「……仲良く」
dialogues.en: "Nice to her..."
dialogues.text: "Nice to her..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「ほらぁ、最近よく遊んでる音夢って子がいる
　でしょ。あの子みたいに守っておやりよ」
dialogues.en:
"You know the girl who you often play with these days, Nemu.
Why don't you treat her in the same way you do to that
girl?"
dialogues.text:
"You know the girl who you often play with these days, Nemu.
Why don't you treat her in the same way you do to that
girl?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「あいつは勝手に家にいるだけだ！」
dialogues.en: "She lives at my house for no reason."
dialogues.text: "She lives at my house for no reason."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "I'm scared..."
dialogues.text: "I'm scared..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「怖くない。なんもしてないだろうが！」
dialogues.en: "Don't be scared. I didn't do anything!"
dialogues.text: "Don't be scared. I didn't do anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おばあちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "Grandma..."
dialogues.text: "Grandma..."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「なにか面倒になってきたから、ふたりで解決
　してくれない？」
dialogues.en: "It's a hassle, so deal with this by yourselves, you two."
dialogues.text: "It's a hassle, so deal with this by yourselves, you two."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Oooh..."
dialogues.text: "Oooh..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺だって泣きたいぞ……」
dialogues.en: "I feel like crying, too."
dialogues.text: "I feel like crying, too."

dialogues.jp: にらめっ子みたいに、ふたりで困る。
dialogues.en: Both of us are at loss doing a staring contest.
dialogues.text: Both of us are at loss doing a staring contest.

dialogues.jp: 唯一の大人は、大人気なく寝た振りをしている。
dialogues.en: The only adult pretends to be asleep.
dialogues.text: The only adult pretends to be asleep.

dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないなぁ……かったるいのに……」
dialogues.en: "What a pain in the neck..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain in the neck..."

dialogues.jp: 子供の俺が、にぎにぎ、と手を動かす。
dialogues.en: I, as a child, squeeze my hands.
dialogues.text: I, as a child, squeeze my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お菓子……おばあちゃんと一緒だ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, a snack... it's the same thing grandma gave me."
dialogues.text: "Oh, a snack... it's the same thing grandma gave me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、なんだ、お前ももらってるのかお菓子」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know you had one already."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know you had one already."

dialogues.jp:
手のひらの上に、いびつであり、かろうじてお
菓子――なのではないかと認識できる物体がのっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
There's a distorted chunk of snack on my palm. It's hard to
describe the shape.
dialogues.text:
There's a distorted chunk of snack on my palm. It's hard to
describe the shape.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちぇ、せっかく手品だぞって驚かせてやろう
　と思ったのに」
dialogues.en: "Shoot... I wanted to surprise you by doing magic."
dialogues.text: "Shoot... I wanted to surprise you by doing magic."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「魔法を使えるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Can you use magic?"
dialogues.text: "Can you use magic?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「これしか出来ないし、まだ上手く出来ないけ
　どな……食えるか饅頭？」
dialogues.en:
"This is the only magic I can do, but it's not very good,
though. Do you like steamed bean-jam buns?"
dialogues.text:
"This is the only magic I can do, but it's not very good,
though. Do you like steamed bean-jam buns?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん……大好きだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I love them."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I love them."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やるよ。オチカヅキノシルシだ」
dialogues.en:
"I'll give you mine. This is a token of our new
acquaintanceship."
dialogues.text:
"I'll give you mine. This is a token of our new
acquaintanceship."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Whoa..."
dialogues.text: "Whoa..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それに、お菓子ってのは魔法の一種なんだぞ」
dialogues.en: "Plus, the snack is a kind of magic."
dialogues.text: "Plus, the snack is a kind of magic."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「食べると元気になるし、美味いし、虫歯には
　なりやすいけど甘い」
dialogues.en:
"When you eat it, you feel more energy, delicious and sweet,
even if it gives you a cavity."
dialogues.text:
"When you eat it, you feel more energy, delicious and sweet,
even if it gives you a cavity."

dialogues.jp: ……なに言ってるんだこいつ？
dialogues.en: What is he talking about?
dialogues.text: What is he talking about?

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、俺がばあちゃんから教わった言葉を言う
のが恥ずかしいのだろう……恥ずかしかった、
のか。
dialogues.en:
I guess I may be feeling embarrassed to say the words I
learned from grandma... or rather, I was embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
I guess I may be feeling embarrassed to say the words I
learned from grandma... or rather, I was embarrassed.

dialogues.jp:
一番の魔法は――泣いている子供に笑顔をあげ
られること。
dialogues.en: The best trick I can do is to smile to a crying child.
dialogues.text: The best trick I can do is to smile to a crying child.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう♪」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う……可愛いじゃねぇか」
dialogues.en: "Hm... you're cute."
dialogues.text: "Hm... you're cute."

dialogues.jp:
その小さな呟きは、さくらの耳に届いてなかっ
た。
dialogues.en: Sakura didn't hear what I mumbled.
dialogues.text: Sakura didn't hear what I mumbled.

dialogues.jp:
子供時代の発言なのだが、今の俺には恥ずかし
くて仕方のない声だ。
dialogues.en:
That was when I was a child, but there is no way I can use
that word now.
dialogues.text:
That was when I was a child, but there is no way I can use
that word now.

dialogues.jp: これが初恋だった気がする……。
dialogues.en: I think that was my first love.
dialogues.text: I think that was my first love.

dialogues.jp: たしか。悔しいことに。
dialogues.en: I'm quite sure, unfortunately.
dialogues.text: I'm quite sure, unfortunately.

dialogues.jp: まったく、子供は可愛い子を見るとすぐに……。
dialogues.en: Damn, whenever a young kid sees a cute girl, he is...
dialogues.text: Damn, whenever a young kid sees a cute girl, he is...

dialogues.jp: やめよう……色んな意味で自爆だ。
dialogues.en: Stop the nonsense... I feel like blowing up my own ship.
dialogues.text: Stop the nonsense... I feel like blowing up my own ship.

dialogues.jp: 「遊びに行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go out?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go out?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え、いいの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ばあちゃんに頼まれたし……かったるいけど
　な。特別に秘密基地に案内してやろう」
dialogues.en:
"It sure is a pain in the neck, but this is what grandma
asked me. I guess I can take you to my secret fort."
dialogues.text:
"It sure is a pain in the neck, but this is what grandma
asked me. I guess I can take you to my secret fort."

dialogues.jp: そっと手が伸びる。
dialogues.en: I reach out my hand slowly.
dialogues.text: I reach out my hand slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん♪」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: そっと手が重なる。
dialogues.en: My hand goes over hers.
dialogues.text: My hand goes over hers.

dialogues.jp:
むにゃむにゃ、と笑いたいのかむずがゆいのか、
俺の口元が動いている。
dialogues.en: My mouth somehow moves either because of a smile or an itch.
dialogues.text: My mouth somehow moves either because of a smile or an itch.

dialogues.jp:
そんな心も知らず、さくらは無邪気な笑顔を向
けてくれる。
dialogues.en:
Without knowing how excited I am, Sakura gives me an
innocent smile.
dialogues.text:
Without knowing how excited I am, Sakura gives me an
innocent smile.

dialogues.jp: あぁ、この時か。
dialogues.en: Oh, this is it.
dialogues.text: Oh, this is it.

dialogues.jp:
いじめているやつから――さくらの笑顔をなく
しているやつから、こいつを守ろうと思ったの
は。
dialogues.en:
This is when I decided to protect her from bullies, people
who take her smiles away.
dialogues.text:
This is when I decided to protect her from bullies, people
who take her smiles away.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりの子供が、無邪気に笑いながら駆けてい
く。
dialogues.en: Two young children run away with innocent minds.
dialogues.text: Two young children run away with innocent minds.

dialogues.jp: あの桜の木の下に。
dialogues.en: Under the cherry tree.
dialogues.text: Under the cherry tree.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「懐かしいかい？」
dialogues.en: "Do you remember the good old days?"
dialogues.text: "Do you remember the good old days?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 驚いた。
dialogues.en: I'm surprised.
dialogues.text: I'm surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「大きくなったねお前も」
dialogues.en: "You've grown, too."
dialogues.text: "You've grown, too."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、あんた……」
dialogues.en: "But you are..."
dialogues.text: "But you are..."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「なんでって別に変じゃないじゃない。別に生
　き返ったわけでもないし」
dialogues.en: "It's not strange at all, because I'm still dead."
dialogues.text: "It's not strange at all, because I'm still dead."

dialogues.jp: ころころ、と鈴を鳴らすような笑みがこぼれる。
dialogues.en: She giggles, like the sound of a bell.
dialogues.text: She giggles, like the sound of a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「これは夢だもの」
dialogues.en: "This is a dream."
dialogues.text: "This is a dream."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "Well, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Well, yeah."

dialogues.jp:
だからって納得しきれるものではないが、まぁ、
言われれば確かに夢なのだこれは。
dialogues.en:
That doesn't mean I can swallow everything that is happening
here, but she is right it's only a dream.
dialogues.text:
That doesn't mean I can swallow everything that is happening
here, but she is right it's only a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「私はただ、子供がささやかな夢を見られる世
　界を作りたかっただけなの」
dialogues.en:
"I just wanted to create a world where the children can keep
their nice memories."
dialogues.text:
"I just wanted to create a world where the children can keep
their nice memories."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「ピーターパンってあるでしょ？　あの話をさ
　くらが好きでね」
dialogues.en:
"Do you know the story of Peter Pan? That's Sakura's
favorite one."
dialogues.text:
"Do you know the story of Peter Pan? That's Sakura's
favorite one."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、ネバーランドでは子供のままでいられ
　る、って設定があるでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you know that when you're in Neverland, you can stay a
child forever?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you know that when you're in Neverland, you can stay a
child forever?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「本当に夢なのかこれ？」
dialogues.en: "Am I really dreaming now?"
dialogues.text: "Am I really dreaming now?"

dialogues.jp: あまりにもリアルタイムな会話な気が。
dialogues.en: She sounds like she is talking to me now.
dialogues.text: She sounds like she is talking to me now.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「夢よ。私はもう死んでるもの」
dialogues.en: "It's a dream. I'm not alive."
dialogues.text: "It's a dream. I'm not alive."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「そっちが夢だっていうほうが、今はよっぽど
　に説得力があるけどな」
dialogues.en: "I feel that you not being alive is a dream."
dialogues.text: "I feel that you not being alive is a dream."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「そう言ってくれると嬉しいけどね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's nice to hear that."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's nice to hear that."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ……さくらを守ってくださいな」
dialogues.en: "Don't forget to protect Sakura, please."
dialogues.text: "Don't forget to protect Sakura, please."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「さくらを？　今は大丈夫だよ。人気者だよあ
　いつは」
dialogues.en: "Sakura? She's okay now. She is a popular girl."
dialogues.text: "Sakura? She's okay now. She is a popular girl."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「本当にそう思うかい？」
dialogues.en: "Do you really believe that?"
dialogues.text: "Do you really believe that?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「あの子も成長したけど、あの外見を見れば分
　かる通りまだ子供なんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"She's grown quite a lot, but as you see from her
appearance, she is still a child."
dialogues.text:
"She's grown quite a lot, but as you see from her
appearance, she is still a child."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「｛そとみ／外見｝ってのは、中身と一緒に成長するんだか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "The appearance grows along with the inside of you."
dialogues.text: "The appearance grows along with the inside of you."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「魔法を解く方法は、本当の恋をするしかない
　んだよ」
dialogues.en:
"The only way to break the spell is to fall in love with
someone."
dialogues.text:
"The only way to break the spell is to fall in love with
someone."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "Uh-huh..."
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh..."

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしいことをペラペラと……。
dialogues.en: She talks about such embarrassing stuff.
dialogues.text: She talks about such embarrassing stuff.

dialogues.jp: 「なんのこと言ってるんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "I don't know what you are talking about."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what you are talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ……あの子の魔法の話」
dialogues.en: "Haha... I'm talking about her magic."
dialogues.text: "Haha... I'm talking about her magic."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「今の私に出来るのはこれだけ」
dialogues.en: "This is all I can do at this moment."
dialogues.text: "This is all I can do at this moment."

dialogues.jp: そっ、とばあちゃんの手が俺の胸に触れる。
dialogues.en: Grandma's gentle hand touches my chest.
dialogues.text: Grandma's gentle hand touches my chest.

dialogues.jp: カチリ――と扉の鍵が開くような音がした。
dialogues.en: I heard the click of the door.
dialogues.text: I heard the click of the door.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「はいお終い……」
dialogues.en: "Here you go..."
dialogues.text: "Here you go..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 胸元をさするが、特に変化らしい変化はない。
dialogues.en: I stroke my chest, but nothing is happening.
dialogues.text: I stroke my chest, but nothing is happening.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、女の子が泣いてるのよ？　私も
　かったるいんだから早くいきなさい！」
dialogues.en:
"Come on, your girl is crying. I'm tired, so you go and help
her now!"
dialogues.text:
"Come on, your girl is crying. I'm tired, so you go and help
her now!"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりにも不意打ちだったが、どか、と縁側に
腰掛けていたばあちゃんの足に蹴り飛ばされる。
dialogues.en: Grandma, sitting on the porch, suddenly kicks me.
dialogues.text: Grandma, sitting on the porch, suddenly kicks me.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、一歩だけ後退しようとするが、足が
地面につかない。
dialogues.en: I try to step back, but my legs don't touch the ground.
dialogues.text: I try to step back, but my legs don't touch the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「うっそ！？」
dialogues.en: "You're kidding me!"
dialogues.text: "You're kidding me!"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、またね♪」
dialogues.en: "See you later, Junichi!"
dialogues.text: "See you later, Junichi!"

dialogues.jp:
落ちているのか浮いているのかも分からない、
不思議な無重力感を覚えながら、白い夢から黒
い闇に落ちた。
dialogues.en:
I don't know if I'm dropping down or floating. All I know is
I'm sinking down into darkness from the happy dream, feeling
a strange weightlessness.
dialogues.text:
I don't know if I'm dropping down or floating. All I know is
I'm sinking down into darkness from the happy dream, feeling
a strange weightlessness.

dialogues.jp: 「音符マークなんてつけんじゃねぇよ〜！！」
dialogues.en: "Don't sound so happy about it!!"
dialogues.text: "Don't sound so happy about it!!"

dialogues.jp: ◆夢・さくらとの出会い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Meeting with Sakura in the dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Meeting with Sakura in the dream◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見た――それはさくらと俺の出会いの夢。
dialogues.en:
I had a dream. It was about the first time I met with
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I had a dream. It was about the first time I met with
Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
いじめられっこだったために、オドオドとしか
しないさくらに、俺は手からお菓子を出す力で
餌付けすることに成功する。
dialogues.en:
She'd been scared and bullied, but I was able to cheer her
up with the snack that I made appear on my hand.
dialogues.text:
She'd been scared and bullied, but I was able to cheer her
up with the snack that I made appear on my hand.

dialogues.jp:
そんな夢を見た後、ばあちゃんと話をすること
になった。
dialogues.en: After the dream, I had a chance to talk with my grandma.
dialogues.text: After the dream, I had a chance to talk with my grandma.

dialogues.jp:
さくらを守ってあげて、と胸元でなにか、扉の
鍵を開くような仕草をされる。
dialogues.en:
She told me to protect Sakura, making a gesture like opening
the lock of a door.
dialogues.text:
She told me to protect Sakura, making a gesture like opening
the lock of a door.

dialogues.jp:
そして、ばあちゃんに無理やり夢から追い出さ
れた。
dialogues.en: And grandma pushed me out of the dream.
dialogues.text: And grandma pushed me out of the dream.
